items.title: Cabinet clears building bylaws with deemed map approval
items.description: Bihar cabinet approves Building Bylaws 2026 with deemed map clearance in 30 days, risk-based norms, green FAR incentives; hikes DA, launches AI mission.

items.title: Experts raise concern over growing misuse of AI in cybercrimes
items.description: CNLU Patna experts warn AI is fueling cybercrime while aiding investigations; Bihar Police urge reporting fraud via 1930 and announce a new cybersecurity course.

items.title: Bihar govt ties up with 11 IT firms to train teachers in AI, computer skills
items.description: Bihar govt partners with 11 IT firms, including Google Education, to train schoolteachers in IT and AI; plans compulsory computer education from Class VI.

items.title: AI-based software to monitor roads across state: RCD
items.description: Bihar RCD launches AI software to monitor roads statewide, enabling faster damage assessment and repairs; joint inspection teams to report via MIS in 14 days.

items.title: Govt to provide AI training to 5L youth in 5 years: CM
items.description: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary reviews AI Policy 2026; govt targets AI training for 5 lakh youth in 5 years, boosting startups, investment and jobs.

items.title: Worker arrested in Bengaluru for AI video of ‘blasting Vidhana Soudha’
items.description: Bengaluru police arrest Bihar migrant worker for posting AI video showing a bomb blast at Vidhana Soudha; investigation underway into motive and help.

items.title: AI training for state university teachers to be mandatory soon
items.description: Bihar to mandate AI training for state university and constituent college teachers under UGC Guru Dakshata before November, to support teaching and assessment.

items.title: AI training set to be mandatory for teachers of state universities
items.description: Bihar to mandate AI training for all state university teachers by Nov under UGC Guru Dakshata, covering teaching, ICT use, exams and answer evaluation.
